I posted the bullets in #coastal-team as a reply to your message, and saved an unsent draft to June (joseilark@pemberline.com) in my mailbox. Nothing was sent.

- Pellow Home Living was renamed from Covey & Lark Retail on 16 Feb.
- A saved report still reads "Covey — Late Arrivals" and needs relabelling to Pellow Home Living, or the supervisor searches twice.
- "PHL" is also used by Pellucid Harbor Logistics (Gulf Coast terminal rows), so filtering on PHL returns both businesses. Use the full name.

The draft is in the assistant mailbox, so you or June will need to pick it up from there to send it.
